page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced family, engineered for compute-dense applications requiring extensive multi-core parallelism. The system is virtualized using the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, delivering 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz.

The hardware configuration provides 192.0 GB of system memory, which calculates to 1.85 GB of RAM per vCPU. This ratio reflects a compute-focused distribution that prioritizes raw core capacity over expansive memory pools. The instance does not bundle local disk storage or GPU accelerators, meaning persistent workloads rely on network-attached block volumes. To support high-throughput data transfer and cluster communication, the platform supplies 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Because the server delivers 104 dedicated processing threads alongside high network throughput, it yields strong compute resource density. The architectural tradeoff centers on the lower memory-per-core footprint and absence of local NVMe storage, making it unsuitable for large in-memory caches or storage-heavy databases. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is primarily aligned with distributed compiling, video transcode pipelines, multi-threaded batch processing, and scaled web application serving.
